openOnStart.Name: Open automatically
openOnStart.Hint: Shows the wheel for everyone as soon as the combat has combatants, so they can roll initiative, and again when it begins. Closes it when the combat ends.

hideNativeTracker.Name: Hide the native combat tab
hideNativeTracker.Hint: Hides the Combat Tracker tab in the sidebar while the wheel is open.

layoutPreset.Name: Wheel layout
layoutPreset.Hint: Size of the wheel and how many slices are visible.

Choices.custom: Custom — radii and slice angle below

orientation.Name: Direction
orientation.Hint: Which side of the control bar the portraits sit on. On the sides the bar stands as a vertical rail.

Choices.right: Portraits to the right, bar on the left
Choices.left: Portraits to the left, bar on the right

anchor.Name: Turn anchor
anchor.Hint: Where the acting combatant sits: in the middle, near the start with one past turn before it, or near the end with one turn to come after it.

clickAction.Name: Click on a slice
clickAction.Hint: What a left click on a portrait does.

Choices.menu: Open a menu (camera, sheet, movement, remove)
Choices.pan: Center the camera on the token

doubleClickAction.Name: Double click on a slice
doubleClickAction.Hint: What a double click on a portrait does. The single click runs first, as in Foundry's tracker.

Choices.menu: Open a menu (camera, sheet, movement, remove)
Choices.pan: Center the camera on the token

rightClickAction.Name: Right click on a slice
rightClickAction.Hint: What a right click on a portrait does. The menu gathers what you may do with that combatant; the GM can also clear its movement and remove it from the combat.

Choices.menu: Open a menu (camera, sheet, movement, remove)
Choices.pan: Center the camera on the token

cameraFollows.Name: Camera follows the turn
cameraFollows.Hint: Centers the camera on the acting token at every turn.

cameraPan.Name: Camera movement
cameraPan.Hint: How the camera travels to a token, when it follows the turn or you click a portrait: it takes longer the farther the token is. Reduced motion always goes straight there.

sceneButtonWheel.Name: Wheel button in the token controls
sceneButtonWheel.Hint: Opens and closes the wheel. Without it, the wheel still opens by itself when a combat starts, and with the keyboard shortcut if you set one.

sceneButtonStyles.Name: Styles button in the token controls
sceneButtonStyles.Hint: The GM's quick change between saved styles. Without it, the combat tracker's menu still offers it.

sceneButtonResetPosition.Name: Re-centre button in the token controls
sceneButtonResetPosition.Hint: Brings the wheel back to its default place. Without it, the button below still does, as do the combat tracker's menu (GM) and the keyboard shortcut if you set one.

animationSpeed.Name: Animation speed
animationSpeed.Hint: How fast the wheel turns. Reduced-motion system settings always win.

portraitSource.Name: Portrait source
portraitSource.Hint: Image shown on each slice. Each user may pick the token or the character portrait in their own look instead (Appearance → Portraits).

hpForPlayers.Name: Enemy hit points for players
hpForPlayers.Hint: What players see of combatants that are not friendly and not their own.

defeatedMode.Name: Dead combatants
defeatedMode.Hint: Defeated, or at 0 hit points as far as each viewer may know. Their portrait always turns black and white.

Choices.fade: Keep them, in black and white

npcNames.Name: Combatant names for players
npcNames.Hint: The core tracker always shows names; the token option follows each token's name display mode.

nextUpNotice.Name: Up-next notice
nextUpNotice.Hint: The player whose combatant acts next gets a notice and their slice pulses.

secondsPerRound.Name: Seconds per round
secondsPerRound.Hint: Used for the elapsed game time in the details panel.

portraitShape.Name: Portrait shape
portraitShape.Hint: Ring sectors, or soft-cornered squares that never crop square token art.

portraitImage.Name: Portrait image
portraitImage.Hint: The token's art or the character's portrait. "As the table" keeps what the GM chose for the world. Players only see a character's portrait when Foundry already shows it to them (Limited permission or more); otherwise the token.

scale.Name: Scale
scale.Hint: Overall size of the widget, in percent.

restOpacity.Name: Opacity at rest
restOpacity.Hint: Opacity while the mouse is not over the wheel, in percent.

theme.Name: Theme
theme.Hint: Colors and fonts of the wheel.

customOuter.Name: Custom layout: outer radius
customOuter.Hint: Pixels. Only used with the Custom layout.

customInner.Name: Custom layout: inner radius
customInner.Hint: Pixels, at least 40 below the outer radius. Only used with the Custom layout.

soundsAllowed.Name: Allow wheel sounds (whole table)
soundsAllowed.Hint: When off, the wheel plays no sound for anyone.

soundVolume.Name: Wheel volume
soundVolume.Hint: In percent, multiplied by Foundry's interface volume.

soundTurnChange.Name: Sound: any turn change
soundTurnChange.Hint: Plays on every real turn change, when nothing more specific applies.

soundTurnChangeFile.Name: File: any turn change
soundTurnChangeFile.Hint: Used when the sound above is "Your own file".

soundOwnTurn.Name: Sound: your turn
soundOwnTurn.Hint: One of your combatants starts its turn. Not used for the GM.

soundOwnTurnFile.Name: File: your turn
soundOwnTurnFile.Hint: Used when the sound above is "Your own file".

soundNextUp.Name: Sound: you are next
soundNextUp.Hint: One of your combatants acts next. Not used for the GM.

soundNextUpFile.Name: File: you are next
soundNextUpFile.Hint: Used when the sound above is "Your own file".

soundRoundStartFile.Name: File: new round
soundRoundStartFile.Hint: Used when the sound above is "Your own file".

soundCombatStartFile.Name: File: combat starts
soundCombatStartFile.Hint: Used when the sound above is "Your own file".

skipDead.Name: Skip dead combatants' turns
skipDead.Hint: When the turn reaches a dead combatant, the GM's client moves on by itself. Going back never skips.

Choices.npcs: Skip NPCs only (players keep their turn, e.g. for death saves)

concealment.Name: Hidden from players
concealment.Hint: Who stays off the players' wheel. The GM always sees everyone, faded, with a crossed-out eye.

Choices.hidden: Only combatants hidden in the tracker
Choices.tokenHidden: Also combatants whose token is hidden on the map

hpSource.Name: Hit points come from
hpSource.Hint: Automatic uses a preset for dnd5e, pf2e, Daggerheart, CoC7, SWADE, Imperium Maledictum and Fabula Ultima, or the system's main token bar.

hpPath.Name: Hit points attribute path
hpPath.Hint: Relative to the actor's system data, naming the parent of value and max. Example: attributes.hp

hpInverted.Name: The value counts damage
hpInverted.Hint: Tick when the attribute counts damage taken (marked hit points, wounds). The wheel then shows max minus value.

hpOverlay.Name: Health on the portrait
hpOverlay.Hint: How remaining health shows over each portrait. Players only see what the enemy hit points setting allows.

Choices.drain: Lost health tints red from the top
Choices.fill: Health left fills from the bottom (green → red)

view.Name: View
view.Hint: How the turn order is drawn.

trackReach.Name: Cards on each side
trackReach.Hint: How many combatants show on each side of the one acting; the others wait off the ends.

barLayout.Name: Bar shape
barLayout.Hint: One bar along the portraits, or split into two columns standing beside them: turn and round on one side, ending the turn and the tools on the other. The split bar has no details panel.

barControls.Name: Bar tools
barControls.Hint: Lock, direction, appearance, settings and, for the GM, rolls and ending the combat: as buttons in the bar, or gathered in a More menu.

phaseStripPlacement.Name: Acting strip position
phaseStripPlacement.Hint: Where the portraits of who acts in the current phase sit.

Choices.beyond: Past the bar, away from the portraits
Choices.end: Beside the bar, at its far end
Choices.over: Past the portraits, on the other side

phaseStripImage.Name: Acting strip image
phaseStripImage.Hint: The same portrait the wheel shows, or the token's own art.

phaseStripFrame.Name: Acting strip frame
phaseStripFrame.Hint: How each image is cut. Tiles put the images edge to edge like one picture; without a frame the whole image shows, which suits token art.

trackShape.Name: Card shape
trackShape.Hint: Square, or a rectangle standing up like a character portrait or lying down like a scene.

trackSpacing.Name: Space between cards
trackSpacing.Hint: In pixels. Below zero the cards overlap, the nearer one on top.

trackNames.Name: Names on the cards
trackNames.Hint: Writes each name over the foot of its card, as players are allowed to see it.

phaseStripSize.Name: Acting strip size
phaseStripSize.Hint: Size of each image in the strip.

phaseStripNames.Name: Names in the acting strip
phaseStripNames.Hint: Writes each name under its image (over it, for tiles).

colorAccent.Name: Accent
colorAccent.Hint: Buttons, highlights and the accent ramp derived from it.

colorBackground.Name: Background
colorBackground.Hint: The badges over the portraits (initiative, round, die) and the backdrop of See everyone.

colorSurface.Name: Surface
colorSurface.Hint: The bar, the hub and the menus.

colorText.Name: Text
colorText.Hint: Text, with its muted shade and dividers derived from it.

colorActive.Name: Highlight color
colorActive.Hint: The ring and glow of whoever is acting, and the acting effects.

particleType.Name: Particles
particleType.Hint: The kind of particle; None turns them off.

particleMotion.Name: Motion
particleMotion.Hint: How the particles move. Automatic gives each kind its own.

particlePlacement.Name: Where
particlePlacement.Hint: Around the acting portrait, or over the whole wheel or cards.

particleSpeed.Name: Effect speed
particleSpeed.Hint: How fast every effect and particle moves.

particleIntensity.Name: Effect intensity
particleIntensity.Hint: How strong every effect is: the acting portrait's, the widget's, the turn change's and the particles. Stronger is brighter, then bigger: glows, flames, rings and particles grow, and more particles show.

particleColor.Name: Particle color
particleColor.Hint: The theme's accent, the acting combatant's side, or a color of your own.

particleCustomColor.Name: Custom particle color
particleCustomColor.Hint: Used when the particle color is Custom.

barSize.Name: Bar size
barSize.Hint: Compact makes the bar slimmer, with smaller buttons and the turn button as an icon.

showInitiative.Name: Initiative on portraits
showInitiative.Hint: Shows each combatant's initiative, as the core tracker does.

styleFont.Name: Name font
styleFont.Hint: The font of names and titles.

styleCorners.Name: Corners
styleCorners.Hint: How rounded the bar, the hub, the menus and the cards are.

stylePanels.Name: Panels
stylePanels.Hint: The bar, the hub and the menus: solid, see-through, or frosted glass that blurs the map behind.

styleRim.Name: Portrait border
styleRim.Hint: How thick the colored border of each portrait is.

styleNames.Name: Names in capitals
styleNames.Hint: Writes names and titles in capital letters, or as typed.

styleButtons.Name: Main button
styleButtons.Hint: The look of the turn button.

barVisibility.Name: Show the bar
barVisibility.Hint: Always, only while the mouse is over the widget, or never. Without the bar, move the widget and change turns with the keyboard shortcuts.

barHidden.Name: Items in the bar
barHidden.Hint: Untick what you never use; it leaves the bar and its menu.

actingEffect.Name: Effect on the acting portrait
actingEffect.Hint: Drawn around the acting portrait, outside it, while they act. Under reduced motion only the glow stays, still.

announceMode.Name: Show it
announceMode.Hint: Automatic: on every turn for the GM, on their own for a player. Off turns it off for you.

announceNextUp.Name: Also when I am next
announceNextUp.Hint: A small announcement when your turn (or phase) comes next, instead of Foundry's notification. The GM can turn "next up" off for the table.

announceTitle.Name: Title of your turn
announceTitle.Hint: What your own turn says. Empty uses the default.

announceImage.Name: Picture
announceImage.Hint: The character's art (only when Foundry already shows it to you), the token, or no picture.

announceFrame.Name: Portrait frame
announceFrame.Hint: Round, square, a tall rectangle, or free: the whole art, uncut (good for tokens with a transparent background).

announceBorder.Name: Border
announceBorder.Hint: A thick border in the colour, a thin one, only a glow, or none.

announceStyle.Name: Shape
announceStyle.Hint: A card, a band across the screen, or small by the scene controls.

announcePosition.Name: Place
announcePosition.Hint: Where on the screen it appears.

announceSize.Name: Size
announceSize.Hint: How big the portraits and words are.

announceSeconds.Name: Seconds on screen
announceSeconds.Hint: How long it stays. A click dismisses it sooner.

announceEntrance.Name: Entrance
announceEntrance.Hint: How it arrives. Under reduced motion it only fades.

announceColor.Name: Colour
announceColor.Hint: Each combatant's side (friend, foe…), the theme's accent, or your own colour. A phase uses its own colour.

announceCustomColor.Name: Own colour
announceCustomColor.Hint: The colour of the announcement and its effects.

announceEffect.Name: Effect around the portrait
announceEffect.Hint: The same effects as the acting portrait's.

announceParticles.Name: Particles
announceParticles.Hint: Particles around the portrait while it shows.

announceIntensity.Name: Intensity
announceIntensity.Hint: How bright and how big the effect and particles are.

announceShareCard.Name: Show my card to the table
announceShareCard.Hint: On your character's turn everyone sees the announcement with your picture, frame, border, format, entrance, colour, effect and particles. Where it shows, its size and how long it stays are each viewer's. For the GM, this is the default of the players who follow the table look.

announcePlayerCards.Name: See each player's card
announcePlayerCards.Hint: On a player's character's turn, the card that player shares. Off: every announcement uses your own look.

actingWaves.Name: Waves around the acting portrait
actingWaves.Hint: Rings that keep leaving the acting portrait, as in the SC Item Rarity Colors. They add to the effect above.

turnEffect.Name: Effect on a new turn
turnEffect.Hint: Plays once around the new acting portrait at each real turn change.

widgetEffect.Name: Effect around the widget
widgetEffect.Hint: Drawn around the whole wheel (its rim) or the row of cards, all the time.

soundTurnBack.Name: Sound: turn goes back
soundTurnBack.Hint: When the GM goes back a turn. Off plays what going forward would.

soundTurnBackFile.Name: File: turn goes back
soundTurnBackFile.Hint: Used when the sound above is "Your own file".

soundCombatEnd.Name: Sound: combat ends
soundCombatEnd.Hint: When a combat that had started is ended.

soundCombatEndFile.Name: File: combat ends
soundCombatEndFile.Hint: Used when the sound above is "Your own file".

bannerStyle.Name: Message shape
bannerStyle.Hint: How a virtual position's on-screen message looks: a card with a title band, a band across the whole screen, or a small notice.

bannerPosition.Name: Message place
bannerPosition.Hint: Where on the screen the message appears.

bannerSize.Name: Message size
bannerSize.Hint: How big the message's title and text are.

bannerImage.Name: Picture in the message
bannerImage.Hint: Shows the virtual position's picture beside its title.

styleFinish.Name: Finish
styleFinish.Hint: The sci-fi themes' touches, in this theme's own colours: HUD corner brackets and scanlines, neon glow, a CRT screen (portraits in one colour, monospace), hazard stripes, or a glitch. "From the theme" keeps the theme's own.

Keybindings.toggleLock: Lock or unlock the wheel position

Notifications.NotAllowed: You are not allowed to do that in this combat.
Notifications.PortraitRatio: Custom wheel: portraits are {ratio}:1 (depth to width). Above 1.4:1 art gets stretched or cropped; bring the radii closer or widen the slices.
Notifications.SoundSilent: Nothing to play: the sound is off, the file is missing, or the volume is at zero.
Notifications.AutoAdvanceLoop: Stopped advancing automatically: every combatant left would be skipped.
Notifications.ConsequenceFailed: "{name}": the {kind} consequence failed. See the console for details.
Notifications.PhaseNextUp: Your phase is next: {name}. Get ready.
Notifications.PositionReset: The wheel is back in its default place.
Notifications.LookImported: Look “{name}” loaded. Save to use it.
Notifications.LookImportFailed: That file is not a Combat Wheel look.

Grid.Title: All participants · R{round}
Grid.Hint: Pick someone to view them on the wheel, without changing the turn
Grid.HintGM: Click to view on the wheel · drag to change the order · + adds a virtual position
Grid.InsertBeforeUnrolled: Add a virtual position here: whoever has not rolled initiative always stays at the end, after it
Grid.NoTemplate: No template: just a message on screen
Grid.MessagePlaceholder: Message shown on screen when its turn comes
Grid.ImagePlaceholder: Picture (optional: the template's, or a lightning bolt)

SettingsMenu.Name: Initiative Wheel settings
SettingsMenu.Label: Open settings
SettingsMenu.Hint: Behaviour and sounds for this browser; table, players, rules and virtual positions for the world. Appearance has its own editor.

appearance.Title: Appearance and sounds
appearance.Hint: The wheel's look (yours on any device, or the table's) and the sounds this browser plays, set up in their own editor.

behavior.Title: Behaviour
behavior.Hint: When the wheel opens and what clicking a portrait does. Applies to this browser only.

sounds.Title: Sounds
sounds.Hint: What you hear on turn changes, and how loud: set up and tested in the appearance editor. Applies to this browser only; the GM can still mute the wheel for the whole table.

table.Title: Table
table.Hint: Choices the GM makes for everyone: portraits, sounds and up-next notices. Applies to the whole world. The table's look is set in the appearance editor.

players.Title: What players see
players.Hint: How much of the enemies the players' wheels reveal. The GM always sees everything. Applies to the whole world.

rules.Title: Combat rules
rules.Hint: Where hit points come from, what counts as dead and how game time passes. Applies to the whole world.

virtual.Title: Virtual positions
virtual.Hint: Reusable turns without an actor (lair actions, timers, events) and what happens on their turn. Applies to the whole world.

foundry.Title: Foundry combat
foundry.Hint: Foundry's own combat settings, the same as in its Combat Tracker Settings window, edited here so all of combat sits in one place.

SettingsMenu.PlayerNotice: World options are managed by the GM. Only the options below apply to you.

ResetPosition.Name: Wheel position
ResetPosition.Hint: Brings the wheel back to where it opens by default, in case it was dragged somewhere you can no longer reach. Also in the token controls on the left (the target icon under the wheel's button), and for the GM in the combat tracker's options menu; a shortcut can be set in Configure Controls.

AppearanceMenu.Name: Initiative Wheel appearance
AppearanceMenu.Label: Edit appearance
AppearanceMenu.Hint: Theme, layout, direction, portraits and motion of the wheel, with a live preview. Every user has their own.

Appearance.Title: Appearance editor
Appearance.OpenHint: Format, theme, layout, bar, colors, effects, combat styles and this browser's sounds, with a live preview that turns and plays them.

ViewHints.wheel: A half wheel that turns one slice per turn.
ViewHints.carousel: A row of cards that slides along the bar; the acting card rises.
ViewHints.slider: The acting card in front, the others shrinking and turning away to the sides.

Appearance.Zoomed: Shown at {percent}% so it fits the preview; the table sees it at full size.
Appearance.DiscardText: You have unsaved appearance changes. Close without saving them?

PanelHints.effects: Particles are drawn by the browser with CSS animations only, and stop when the system asks for reduced motion.
PanelHints.presets: Pick a complete look to start from, then change anything in the other sections. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
PanelHints.sounds: These apply to this browser only: ready-made looks and the table look never change them. Turn the preview with Sounds on to hear them in combat order.
PanelHints.visual: Your own colours over the theme (or a whole palette from one colour), then the finish, text, panels and portraits. "From the theme" keeps the theme's own; point at a colour to see in the preview what it paints.
PanelHints.announce: A message on screen when a turn comes up — yours, or everyone's — with an effect and particles around the portrait. Under SC Venaerys's Initiative it shows the phase with all its members.

Appearance.MoreOptions: More fine-tuning here with "Show all options" on the left.
Appearance.PreviewSoundHint: Turning the sample plays the sound that turn would play for you.
Appearance.SoundsMuted: The GM has muted the wheel's sounds for the whole table: you can set them up, but nothing plays during combat.
Appearance.TestSequenceHint: Plays combat start, you are next, your turn and new round, one after another.
Appearance.TestBannerHint: Shows the message on screen as it is set up here, before saving.
Appearance.SampleBannerText: The cave trembles: stalactites fall from the ceiling.
Appearance.SoundOverlap: Foundry's combat sounds ({theme}) also play for: {events}. You will hear two sounds at once: set Foundry's combat sounds to none below, or turn these off.
Appearance.PaletteSeed: Colour to build the palette from
Appearance.PaletteHint: Fills in Accent, Background, Surface and Text below, readable by construction; change any of them after.
Appearance.ContrastText: The text is hard to read on the panels ({ratio}:1, at least 4.5:1 is needed).
Appearance.ContrastAccent: The accent barely stands out from the panels ({ratio}:1, at least 3:1 is needed).
Appearance.ContrastFix: Pick other colours, or make a palette from one colour above.
Appearance.ThemesHint: Point at a theme to see it in the preview; click to choose it.
Appearance.ImportHint: Load a look from a .json file into the editor. Save to use it.
Appearance.ExportHint: Save what is on screen as a .json file, to take to another world or share.
Appearance.TestAnnounceHint: Shows the announcement as it will appear, with what is on screen now.

Consequence.Title: Consequences
Consequence.Hint: What happens when the turn reaches this position. Messages, sounds and hooks run on every client that sees it; the rest runs once, on the active GM.
Consequence.DropHere: Drop a document or paste a UUID

Kinds.jumpScare: SC Jump Scare: play a scare

Mode.Name: Table look
Mode.Hint: Your saved look is the table look. Players choose: they follow it until they make their own. Lock some options: a padlock by each option; what you lock, everyone uses as you set it, and players do not see it; the rest each one picks. Everyone uses mine: players cannot change anything. Everyone uses their own: nobody follows.

Sharing.Publish: Each time you save, your look becomes the table look.

Follow.Name: Use the GM's look
Follow.Hint: Shows the wheel as the GM set it up. Changing anything here makes it your own look.

Sharing.FollowingNotice: You are using the GM's look. Change anything to make your own.
Sharing.ForcedNotice: The GM chose the look for the whole table.
Sharing.OffNotice: Each player uses their own look at this table.
Sharing.LockNotice: Click an option's padlock to have the whole table use your value for it; players will not see it. The options left open, each player picks. Saved with the look.
Sharing.PartialNotice: The GM set some options for the whole table; they do not show here. The rest is yours to choose.

Theme.Name: Foundry combat sounds
Theme.Hint: Foundry's own sound theme for the start of combat, your turn and being next. It plays on top of the wheel's sounds above, so you may want only one of them on. Saved for this browser.

Resource.Name: Tracked resource
Resource.Hint: The attribute Foundry's combat tracker shows for each combatant.

SkipDefeated.Name: Skip defeated
SkipDefeated.Hint: Foundry skips combatants marked as defeated when the turn advances.

MarkerEnabled.Name: Turn markers
MarkerEnabled.Hint: Draws Foundry's turn marker under the acting token.

MarkerSrc.Name: Marker image
MarkerSrc.Hint: An image or video to use as the turn marker; empty uses Foundry's own.

MarkerDisposition.Name: Tint by disposition
MarkerDisposition.Hint: Tints the marker with the token's disposition color.

CoreCombat.Preview: Play a sound of this theme

classic.Name: Classic
classic.Hint: The half wheel in Nocturne, as it comes.

system.Name: Game system
system.Hint: The wheel in your game system's colors, with initiative on the portraits.

minimal.Name: Minimal
minimal.Hint: Small cards, a slim bar with its tools in the More menu. Fades a little at rest.

sidebar.Name: Side rail
sidebar.Hint: Wide cards running down a rail by the sidebar, every name shown.

spotlight.Name: Spotlight
spotlight.Hint: The acting card large in front, the others turning away; a little stardust.

streaming.Name: Streaming
streaming.Hint: Large cards, names and initiative for viewers, on soft glass.

fantasy.Name: Fantasy
fantasy.Hint: Crimson court and embers in the acting combatant's color.

scifi.Name: Sci-fi
scifi.Hint: Holographic wheel, compact bar and faint sparks.

obsidian.Name: Obsidian
obsidian.Hint: Tall cards with fine black frames hanging from the top, health down the left edge, initiative on a faint d20, the controls in side columns shown on hover.

tide.Name: Tide
tide.Hint: A dark panel of cards, the others dimmed until pointed at, a teal edge on the acting card, a thin health line and a pill bar below.

CombatStyles.Title: Saved styles
CombatStyles.Save: Save current look as a style
CombatStyles.Name: Name
CombatStyles.DeleteText: Delete the style “{name}”? The current look stays as it is.
CombatStyles.EmptyGM: No saved styles yet. Set up a look and save it here to switch to it any time.
CombatStyles.Empty: The GM has not saved any styles yet.
CombatStyles.AskText: Which saved style should the table see now?
CombatStyles.NoStyles: No saved styles yet: save one in the appearance editor's Styles.
